analyst.summary: Bajaj Finserv is the listed holding company for Bajaj Finance (its main lending arm, ~51% owned) and, since March 2026, for 100%-Bajaj-group-owned life and general insurers (rebranded Bajaj Life Insurance and Bajaj General Insurance after a ~₹21,390 crore buyout of Allianz's stake). The core lending business remains healthy - loan growth around 22-24% with asset quality actually improving after the company proactively reined in a stressed small-business/two-wheeler lending pocket earlier in the year. Life insurance is performing well; general insurance had a weak quarter on government health-scheme claims that bears watching. The stock's headline valuation (about 30 times earnings) looks full against a modest return on equity, but a sum-of-the-parts check shows the market isn't really paying extra for the insurance and newer businesses on top of the Bajaj Finance stake - so this reads as fairly valued rather than expensive. We rate it Hold: a quality, well-run business at a valuation with limited room for disappointment, not a name to exit.
